capabilities: Track pantry stock with automatic unit normalization to g, ml, and pcs
Chat with an AI butler to generate meal plans from available ingredients
Deduct ingredient quantities from the pantry when accepting a meal plan
Compute calories, protein, carbs, and fats from an embedded offline USDA/FDC database
Show a 12-column dashboard with meal tracker, pantry levels, and kitchen tasks
extras: Not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Installed manually by extracting a release zip into .obsidian/plugins/pantryfin/, including a 4 MB fdc-data.json database file and a separate index file.
problem: Obsidian has no way to track grocery stock and nutrition; mixed units (kg, g, L, ml) and manual calorie logging lead to errors and disconnected meal records.

relations.evidence: Packed with an embedded, lightning-fast 4.0 MB USDA/FDC food database

summary: AI meal planner that tracks a kitchen pantry in normalized units, chats with an AI nutritionist to plan meals, and calculates calories and macros offline.
